exercises.question: Which tense sets the background? [¿Qué tiempo establece el contexto?]
options: Había mucha gente en la estación. [There were a lot of people at the station.]
El tren salió a las ocho. [The train left at eight.]
Anunciaron la cancelación. [They announced the cancellation.]

exercises.sentence: Cuando llegamos a la estación, __ mucha gente. [When we arrived at the station, there were a lot of people.] (haber)

exercises.english: The train left late because there was a breakdown.

sentences: Llegamos a la estación. [We arrived at the station.]
Descubrimos que había una avería. [We discovered that there was a breakdown.]
El tren salió con retraso. [The train left late.]

exercises.question: Which sentence places one past event before another? [¿Cuál sitúa un acontecimiento anterior a otro pasado?]
options: Ya habíamos comprado otro billete cuando llegó el mensaje. [We had already bought another ticket when the message arrived.]
Compramos otro billete cuando llegó el mensaje. [We bought another ticket when the message arrived.]
Comprábamos otro billete cuando llegó el mensaje. [We were buying another ticket when the message arrived.]

exercises.sentence: Mientras __, anunciaron la cancelación. [While we were waiting, they announced the cancellation.] (esperar)

exercises.english: We had already bought another ticket when the message arrived.

exercises.sentence: El tren salió con retraso porque había una avería.
options: The train left late because there was a breakdown.
The train will leave late because there is a delay.
We cancelled the train because it was early.
While we were waiting, they announced the cancellation.
While we waited tomorrow, they will cancel it.
We had already cancelled it before waiting.

exercises.sentence: Ya habíamos comprado otro billete cuando llegó el mensaje.
Cuando llegamos a la estación, había mucha gente.
options: When we arrived at the station, there were a lot of people.
When we arrive tomorrow, there will be few people.
We had arrived because there were many trains.
Había mucha gente y el tren salió con retraso. [There were a lot of people and the train left late.]
Habrá mucha gente y el tren saldrá con retraso ayer. [There will be many people and the train will leave late yesterday.]
Hay mucha gente y el tren salía mañana. [There are many people and the train was leaving tomorrow.]
Porque ya había una avería y anunciaron un retraso. [Because there was already a breakdown and they announced a delay.]
Porque habrá una avería ayer. [Because there will be a breakdown yesterday.]
Porque había comprado el tren mañana. [Because I had bought the train tomorrow.]
No, pero el retraso nos obligó a cambiar de plan. [No, but the delay forced us to change our plan.]
No, pero el retraso nos obligará ayer. [No, but the delay will force us yesterday.]
No, pero cancelábamos el viaje mañana. [No, but we used to cancel the journey tomorrow.]

template.prompt: Narrate a travel problem using the imperfecto and indefinido.
template.answer: Mientras esperábamos en la estación, anunciaron un retraso y tuvimos que cambiar de plan.

template.prompt: Explain what had already happened before a later event using the pluscuamperfecto.
template.answer: Ya habíamos comprado otro billete cuando llegó el mensaje.
